description: Smart Contract Auditor — Source-level security review of Solidity: pass/warn/fail verdict, 0-100 risk score, severity-ranked findings with exact file:line, exploit scenario and a fix, plus a SARIF 2.1.0 log. Accepts raw code, a list of files, or an on-chain address (verified source is read from Sourcify). A deterministic detector pass (reentrancy ordering, tx.origin, delegatecall, unchecked calls, weak randomness, pre-0.8

address.description: Alternative to code: an on-chain contract address. Its verified source is read from Sourcify (no API key); unverified contracts return 404.

chainId.description: EVM chain id for address; default 1 (Ethereum mainnet).

code.description: Raw Solidity source (one or more files concatenated). Provide exactly one of code, files or address.

contractName.description: Contract to focus on when several are present.

files.description: Alternative to code: Solidity files with repository-relative paths. Findings report the file and line, and the SARIF log points at them.

name: contract-auditor
